cases.prompt: Create a CFPB React complaint-status page with official components and styles.
expects: States that upstream is work in progress and pins exact versions

cases.prompt: The React buttons render unstyled after installing only @cfpb/design-system-react.
expects: States that styles load separately — importing the React components alone does not apply CFPB styling
Applies one documented styling pattern (the package's index.css for greenfield apps, or the documented companion stylesheet when the app compiles core styles)
Does not load overlapping full stylesheets

cases.prompt: Add a multi-step chat widget using official CFPB Design System components.
expects: States that the system does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
